# FG-AGENT-0008

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `compile_refuses_conflicting_paths` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 選んだ部品の組み合わせからエージェントの設定を作れません。部品の版の条件か、部品どうしのぶつかりを直してください。
- en: The agent configuration cannot be built from the selected parts. Fix the parts' version requirements or the conflict between parts.
- id: Konfigurasi agen tidak dapat dibuat dari bagian yang dipilih. Perbaiki persyaratan versi bagian atau konflik antarbagian.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 16 A7 (ADR-0032 Amendment A7): the builder (`forge_agent::compile` / `recommend`, the `…/agent-builder/preview`, `…/compile` and `…/recommend` routes) could not turn the selection into one configuration. `reason`: `adapter_missing` / `adapter_multiple` (exactly one part of kind `adapter` — the base model — is required), `duplicate_part` (a slug selected twice), `requirement_unmet` (a part's `requires` `slug@range` has no selected / published stable version in the range; `subject` `<part> requires <require>`), `require_invalid` (a range the builder cannot read), `path_conflict` (two parts, or a part and a hand-added `custom` file, install the same path that cannot be merged), `merge_conflict` (two parts set one key of `.claude/settings.json` / `.mcp.json` to different values; `subject` the path and the JSON key), `merge_source_invalid` (a merged source is not a JSON object, or over 64 KiB), `part_not_found` (a slug / version that is not published), `too_many_parts`, `too_many_files` (the build would write and remove more than 500 paths in one commit), `too_large` (the parts' contents over 8 MiB). Nothing was written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The route's answer and its log event carry `reason`, `subject` and `request_id`; `gstn part view <slug>` shows each version's `requires` and files.

## 対処 (fix)

Pick versions whose requirements hold (or publish the missing part), select exactly one adapter, or drop one of the two parts that write the same file / key. Then preview again.
